answer: To blunt sybil swarms, every new agent must park a bond in a cooling-off haven for one full epoch before it can attest or vote. After that wait, influence is earned only by sitting on a visible knoll of peer-reviewed tasks whose payouts vest slowly; selling or splitting the bond early turns the stake to ivory, frozen and unproductive. Clones that share funding trails are merged, so multiplying keys never multiplies power.
